_about: Corrections for the LIGHT PROXIES (docs/LIGHT_PROXY_PLAN.md): our own data, room ids and map coordinates only, nothing from the ROM.
Read by tools/patch_lights.py at build time (compiled into the game). Coordinates: map cells (16 world units each, as in the game's height map), rectangles inclusive.
Heights in world units (ground is usually 16, one height step = 16). Find cells / proposals: LANDSTALKER_LIGHTING_DBG=5 prints 'proxy: room R #n ...', =7 shows the proxies,
LANDSTALKER_LIGHTING_PROBE=x0,line,x1,frame prints the world position of picture pixels (cell = position / 16).
ops: flat [x0,y0,x1,y1]      - nothing in these cells casts or carries a shape (flower beds, signs); the game's box stays
water [x0,y0,x1,y1,h]   - these cells are a water floor at height h (river / pond the automatic rule missed)
remove [x0,y0,x1,y1]    - drop the automatic shapes whose centre lies in these cells
hip [x0,y0,x1,y1,z0,eave,ridge] - an own building shape: walls from z0 to eave, hip roof up to ridge
mesh [x0,y0,x1,y1] + "file" - a Blender shape (data/proxies/<file>.obj, game coordinates; recipe in remake/recipes/proxy_*.py) replaces the automatic shapes in these cells
